style_context: Land surveying, field measurement, property mapping, elevation work, GPS positioning, and construction layout

images.description: Clean instructional scene on an open practice lot: two surveyors in clean field clothing, one operating a tripod-mounted total station centered over a corner stake and the other holding a prism pole at another marked corner, with a few visible boundary stakes and simple callouts labeling the instrument, prism pole, reference corner, and measured line; no logos or branding text
images.value: Shows the spatial relationship between the total station, prism pole, and corner stakes in one field setup — a layout that text alone cannot convey clearly

images.description: Instructional close-to-mid shot of a Scout in appropriate outdoor field clothing performing a tick check after surveying in brush, focusing on socks, pant cuffs, and lower legs beside neatly set-down survey gear, with a few simple callouts marking common tick-check spots; no logos or branding text
images.value: Shows exactly where to inspect clothing and skin after brush work — inspection locations that are easier to learn visually than from text alone

images.description: Clean top-down educational diagram of an open field notebook page for a radial survey, showing one station point at a lot corner, several angle rays spreading to other corners and to a tree, shrub, and rock, plus a neat field-note table with short labels for point name, angle, distance, and remarks; minimal text only, no branding
images.value: Combines the spoke-like geometry of a radial survey with the matching notebook layout — a visual connection between field positions and recorded notes that text cannot show efficiently

images.description: Close instructional view of hands using a protractor and engineer scale on graph paper to plot survey points from field notes, with subtle callouts labeling reference line, angle mark, scaled distance, and plotted point; realistic desktop scene, no logos or branding text
images.value: Shows how the protractor, scale, and plotted point work together on the page — hand placement and tool alignment that text alone cannot teach well

images.description: Outdoor instructional scene with one Scout sighting through a builder's level on a tripod and another Scout holding a leveling rod straight on a marked corner, with simple callouts for level line of sight, upright rod, benchmark corner, and field notebook reading; clean field clothing, no logos or branding text
images.value: Shows the correct relationship between level, rod, and benchmark in one moment — positioning and posture that are hard to understand from text alone

images.description: Two-panel comparison image: left panel shows a drone mapping an open construction site from above with ground control markers visible, right panel shows a tripod laser scanner capturing the facade of a building and nearby surfaces; clean instructional composition, no logos or branding text
images.value: Shows the very different kinds of scenes each technology captures best — a contrast in viewpoint and use case that text alone cannot make immediate

images.description: Instructional field scene of a survey-grade GPS receiver mounted on a pole in an open area with clear sky, held by a surveyor in clean field clothing, with simple callouts labeling receiver, survey pole, open-sky signal path, and ground point coordinate location; no logos or branding text
images.value: Shows the physical setup GPS surveying depends on, especially the receiver-on-pole arrangement and need for open sky — a field configuration easier to grasp visually than through text alone
